quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on the Clippers' late-game turnover struggles
quotes.excerpt: when you come down the stretch you got to be able to execute at least take care of the basketball
quotes.quote: Turnover, turnover, turnover, turnover. You right there in the game, you play well on the road, and it goes from a three-point game, or really a five-point game, with 4:14 we got the ball, to a 14-point game in a minute. We got to learn. We keep talking about the turnovers, but we didn't have a great offensive night tonight, but when you come down the stretch you got to be able to execute at least take care of the basketball, and we weren't able to do that tonight.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue on the Clippers late game struggles: We keep talking about the turnovers but we did not have a great offensive night and when you come down the stretch you have to be able to execute and take care of the basketball.

quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue attributes late-game collapse to offensive execution and turnovers
quotes.excerpt: you can't make up for turnovers, it's too hard
quotes.quote: It's the offense. You can't get stops if you turn the ball over. If you go back and watch it, a three-point game, and dunk, dunk, dunk, layup, three. quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue on the late game collapse: You cannot get stops if you turn the ball over. You cannot make up for turnovers it is too hard.
